_note: Reference data supplied by the owner on 2026-08-13 for the Part 2/3 onboarding + admin-curriculum work (streams/combinations for Class 11-12, admin-manageable). Not yet wired into any schema or UI -- see docs/REBUILD_HANDOFF.md section 6b for the design decision this backs. Preserved verbatim; do not summarise away the CBSE-vs-Kerala differences on the assumption they're minor -- they determine which subjects a student is even offered.

high_school_classes_8_to_10.overview: Students take a foundational set of core subjects without streaming.

subjects.cbse: Mathematics (Standard or Basic option in Class 10)

subjects.kerala_state: Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Taught and tested as 3 separate subjects)

subjects.cbse: IT, AI, or other skill subjects (Optional)

higher_secondary_classes_11_and_12.overview: Students choose a specific stream. CBSE offers mix-and-match flexibility with one mandatory language. Kerala Board requires two languages and uses strict predefined subject combinations.

commerce.focus: Finance, accounting, business management, and CA/CS

humanities_arts.focus: Law, civil services, journalism, psychology, and social sciences

cbse.options: Highly flexible pool including History, Political Science, Geography, Sociology, Psychology, Economics, Legal Studies, and Fine Arts.

kerala_state.combinations: Predefined blocks (e.g., History, Economics, Political Science, and Sociology).
